content:
Ted Lasso Season 4 finale drops today, and to coincide with the premiere, Apple has released a free preview chapter of Trent Crimm's book 'The Richmond Way'.

"The Richmond Way" preview chapter, penned by Trent Crimm, is now available.

If you've already watched the Ted Lasso finale and want to keep the good times rolling, Apple has just the bit of "extra content" for you to savour today.

Apple Books has just published a preview chapter of Trent Crimm's fictional book 'The Richmond Way'.

You can listen to the audiobook, narrated by Crimm himself, or read the text version.

Below is the link to download it via Apple Books:

Here's the official book synopsis:

To celebrate the return of the hit Apple Original series Ted Lasso, we're gifting an exclusive preview chapter from the second printing of reporter Trent Crimm's bestselling book 'The Richmond Way'. When the book was first published, former The Independent investigative journalist Trent Crimm's account of AFC Richmond's extraordinary season caused quite a stir among fans and a few begrudgers. To mark the book's second print run, Trent is offering a sneak peek at one of his favourite chapters, along with a "letter from the author" offering further behind-the-scenes insights.

The audiobook preview runs for 15 minutes, so it won't take up too much of your time.

Although Ted Lasso Season 4 has received decent reviews, the powers that be have yet to announce a renewal for Season 5. However, reports suggest Apple is already quietly gearing up for a new season.

Would you like to see Ted Lasso run for a few more seasons? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs US$14.99 (approximately HK$117) per month, or you can get a discount by bundling it with Apple One.
